issue.title: Fix auto linking urls with subdomain with underscore.

repository.name: cakephp
repository.description: CakePHP: The Rapid Development Framework for PHP - Official Repository

body:
Unfortunately, now works for www.sub_domain.domain.pl and www.doma_in.pl.
Ofcourse 2nd address not shoud be parsed.

As per specs:

> Host names are not allowed to have underscores in them. In DNS, host names are the name fields of A or MX records or the data fields of the SOA and NS records. Thus, there are many DNS entries that are not hostnames.

Source: http://domainkeys.sourceforge.net/underscore.html

> "Other DNS names may contain the underscore. Systems such as DomainKeys and service records"

Source: http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hostname

And

> Hostnames can contain letters, numbers, and hyphens, and may not start with a hyphen. Underscore (_) is not a valid character in a hostname. While there are some DNS server software packages available that allow underscore within published host names, most do not. Using a domain or host name with an underscore will cause most name servers on the Internet to stop recognizing the related host/IP address. 

There are also known issues with [IE and cookies](http://www.schwammysays.net/problems-with-underscore-in-urls/) regarding underscored subdomains. But that is a little bit off topic :)

So since all (sub)domains are also host names that change was probably invalid.
And for checking DNS entries as a whole there should be a different regex/method for it that is less strict.

But to cover those edge cases for the TextHelper where people really want to use the not recommended underscore domains we should probably allow this change.
As @markstory mentioned: Rather too many than too few.
Just be warned: It is still a bad idea to go down that road.
I don't see a problem with allowing underscore too. If you have www.doma_in.pl in your content then your problem is that you have an invalid domain; whether it get linked or not becomes irrelevant.
Also if you guys notice github too auto links `www.domain_in.pl` ;)
Good point :) The content is then potentially invalid. Linked or not.
I would prefer linking _too many_ domains over missing some.

I still thnik, we not should be uses domain with underscore but subdomain yes. But there is other problem: TextHelper::autoLink generate anchor from string like this: ```

http://www

- www coś tam

- www something

www używając

www something

- www używając

- www something

- http://www

text www text

- text www text

``` Give not correct effect: ```

http://www

- www coś tam

- www something 

www używając

www something

- www używając

- www something

- http://www

text www text

- text www text

```
We had a few other reports in the past about URLs with spaces not being linked correctly. I would rather not reopen those issues to fix edge cases. http://www can easily be a valid host name.
Using DOMDocument might not work with all uses of TextHelper, as HTML4 and HTML5 allow formatting that is not compatible with XML.
Ok, about DOMDocument I do not know too much, but I thinking it's my RegExp is fine:)

issue.title: Text->autoLinkUrls ending dot in sentences must not be included in URL.

repository.name: cakephp
repository.description: CakePHP: The Rapid Development Framework for PHP - Official Repository

issue.body:
I have for example following url in a sentence:

Look at the following webpage https://github.com/google/physical-web.

The sentence is ending with a dot like it supposed to, but Text->autoLinkUrls is including the . in the url witch is thereby not working anymore.
